description: Sixteen buttons sent out as one polyphonic cable, each button choosing between an off voltage and an on voltage.

params.text: Sends the off voltage while it is up and the on voltage while it is pressed, 0V and 10V until the menu or the A and B inputs change them.
Sets how many channels the output carries, 1 to 16, or automatic at the far left, which follows the greater of the A and B channel counts.

inputs.text: Sets the voltage sent by a button that is up; a monophonic cable sets it for every channel and a polyphonic cable sets it channel by channel.
Sets the voltage sent by a button that is pressed down; a monophonic cable sets it for every channel and a polyphonic cable sets it channel by channel.

outputs.text: Carries one channel per button, each at its off or on voltage.

menu: Exclusive Mode (like radio buttons: only can be pressed at a time) — pressing one button releases the rest.
Momentary (gate output while button is held) — a button sends its on voltage only while it is held down.
Off / On Values (A ... B) — picks the pair of voltages the buttons send: 0-10V, -5V to +5V, 0-5V, 0-1V, -1V to +1V, or -10V to +10V.
